title: DevOps Engineer Intern
description:
**Internship: DevOps & Deployment Engineer Intern**

**Company:** Eitonics Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Product:** LOBMAX PCS-D – HealthTech SaaS Platform  
**Location:** NIET TBI, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Duration:** 6–12 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹8,000 per month  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, or a related field  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time Internship  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office

About Eitonics Technologies

Eitonics Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a growing technology startup developing digital solutions across HealthTech and HospitalityTech.

Our HealthTech product, LOBMAX PCS-D, is a cloud-based dialysis center management platform. We are looking for a technically enthusiastic intern to help manage our cloud infrastructure, application deployments, backups, recovery procedures, and mobile application releases.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on **DevOps & Deployment Engineer Intern** who can assist with the day-to-day technical operations of our live applications and servers.

The candidate will work on Linux VPS management, application deployment, database backups and restoration, troubleshooting, server monitoring, and publishing Android and iOS applications.

This is a practical role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems and wants experience managing real-world cloud applications.

Key Responsibilities1. VPS & Server Management

* Manage and maintain Linux-based VPS environments.
* Work with CloudPanel, SSH, Nginx/Apache, domains, DNS, and SSL certificates.
* Monitor server availability, disk usage, memory, CPU, and application logs.
* Troubleshoot server errors, connectivity issues, and application downtime.
* Maintain server configurations, permissions, environment variables, and security updates.

2. Application Deployment & Maintenance

* Deploy updates to existing web applications and backend services.
* Manage PHP/MySQL applications and Node.js backend services.
* Assist with Flutter application build and release workflows.
* Configure production environments and troubleshoot deployment failures.
* Use Git/GitHub for version control and maintain deployment documentation.
* Test changes before release and assist with rollback when a deployment fails.

3. Backup, Restore & Recovery

* Set up and maintain scheduled database and application backups.
* Back up MySQL databases, application files, and essential configurations.
* Test backup restoration in a safe environment.
* Maintain backup logs and document recovery procedures.
* Assist in disaster recovery planning and periodic recovery testing.

4. Android & iOS App Publishing

* Prepare Android application builds and assist with Google Play Console submissions.
* Manage app versioning, release notes, testing, and production updates.
* Assist with iOS builds, signing, provisioning profiles, and App Store Connect submissions.
* Troubleshoot build and app submission issues.
* Coordinate app releases and ensure that the correct backend API endpoints are configured.

5. Technical Support & Troubleshooting

* Investigate server, deployment, database connectivity, and application errors.
* Assist developers with production issues and basic bug fixes where required.
* Maintain technical documentation, deployment checklists, and server maintenance records.
* Follow secure practices when accessing production systems and handling customer data.

Required Skills

* B.Tech / B.E. graduate in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of Linux commands and SSH.
* Familiarity with web hosting, domains, DNS, and SSL.
* Basic knowledge of PHP, MySQL, or backend application deployment.
* Understanding of Git and version control.
* Willingness to learn VPS administration, backups, recovery, and mobile app releases.
* Good troubleshooting skills and a responsible approach to production systems.

**Good to have:** Experience with CloudPanel, Linux VPS hosting, Nginx, Node.js, Flutter, Google Play Console, or App Store Connect.

Stipend & Growth Opportunity

* Monthly stipend of ₹8,000.
* Practical experience managing live cloud applications.
* Hands-on exposure to server administration, deployment, backup recovery, and mobile app publishing.
* Opportunity to develop DevOps, cloud operations, and release engineering skills.
* Potential full-time employment based on performance and business requirements.

Ideal Candidate

We need a dependable, hands-on learner who can follow technical procedures, investigate errors, document changes, and take responsibility for assigned tasks.

Candidates with personal projects, Linux practice, VPS hosting experience, or experience deploying any web or mobile application will be preferred.

**Apply with your resume and details of any applications you have deployed or servers you have managed.**

Pay: ₹8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Track Manager - Mainframe Automation Tools
description:
Track Manager - Mainframe Automation Tools

Noida, Uttar Pradesh

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Java Platform Engineer is responsible for owning, maintaining, enhancing, and governing common Java libraries, utilities, frameworks, and shared components developed as part of Mainframe Modernization . These reusable assets serve as foundational building blocks for multiple modernized applications and are distributed through the enterprise artifact repository.

The role focuses on ensuring shared Java components are reliable, maintainable, secure, versioned appropriately, and consumable by application teams. The engineer will work closely with application development teams, platform engineering, architecture, testing teams, and business SMEs to support the long-term operational ownership of common code ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Strong hands-on Java development experience, including design, development, troubleshooting, refactoring, and production support.

* Experience maintaining enterprise Java frameworks, reusable libraries, and shared platform components.

* Strong understanding of Maven, Gradle, dependency management, and artifact lifecycle management.

* Experience with Artifactory or similar enterprise artifact repositories.

* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality controls, and release management.

* Experience with GitHub, source control management, branching strategies, and pull request processes.

* Familiarity with legacy modernization, mainframe-to-Java migration, code conversion, or re-platforming initiatives.

* Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; DB2 LUW experience preferred.

* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

* Ability to work across multiple application teams and manage shared-code dependencies.

* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Own the lifecycle of common Java libraries, utilities, frameworks, and reusable services.

* Maintain and enhance shared components while ensuring backward compatibility and minimal disruption to consuming applications.

* Establish and enforce standards for reusable code, library design, packaging, and consumption.

Artifact Repository Management

* Build, package, version, and publish approved Java artifacts to Artifactory.

* Manage artifact versioning, release governance, dependency tracking, and deprecation strategies.

* Ensure shared artifacts are properly documented and available for enterprise consumption.

Development & Support

* Review, maintain, and enhance converted Java utilities, common-code components, and shared services delivered through Mainframe modernization.

* Analyze code for maintainability, performance, reliability, operational supportability, and security.

* Support defect triage, root-cause analysis, remediation planning, and validation activities involving shared platform components.

Consumer Team Enablement

* Partner with application teams consuming shared libraries and common services.

* Provide guidance on library adoption, upgrade planning, dependency management, and integration best practices.

* Support onboarding of new application teams to common components.

Build, Release & Quality Engineering

* Maintain build pipelines and automated validation processes for shared components.

* Implement and support automated testing, code quality analysis, and security scanning.

* Ensure artifacts meet enterprise quality, security, and compliance standards before publication.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* + Mainframe modernization and legacy application transformation initiatives.

  + Shared services or platform engineering organizations.

  + Enterprise artifact repositories such as Artifactory.

  + Maven Central style dependency management and semantic versioning.

  + CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar.

  + Enterprise-scale Java application support.

  + Cloud-hosted Java workloads and distributed application architectures.

  Success Measures

  + Stability and reliability of shared Java components.

  + Successful adoption of common libraries across applications.

  + Reduction of duplicate code and implementation inconsistencies.

  + Effective version governance and dependency management.

  + High-quality documentation and support readiness.

  + Timely resolution of defects impacting consuming applications.

title: DevOps Engineer - Noida
description:
**Role \-** **DevOps Enginee**r

**Location:** India \- Noida

**Type:** Full\-time

**Department:** R\&D

**About NeoXam**


NeoXam is a leading B2B fintech software vendor serving buy\-side investment managers and asset servicers globally. Our platform covers data management, reconciliation, fund accounting, reporting, and portfolio management. As we scale, we are investing in the reliability, automation, and security of the infrastructure and delivery pipelines that power our platform.

**The Role**


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own the design, automation, and reliability of our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.


The problem space is clear: engineering teams need fast, safe, and repeatable ways to build, test, and ship software across multiple products and client environments. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with end\-to\-end ownership, from infrastructure design to production operations. As the initiative matures, you will have the opportunity to shape standards adopted across engineering.

**What You Will Work On**

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support multiple engineering teams and products
* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent) across environments
* Deploy, operate, and scale containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes
* Build monitoring, logging, and alerting systems that give engineering and support teams real visibility into production health
* Automate configuration management, release processes, and routine operational tasks to reduce manual toil
* Define and enforce security, access control, and secrets management practices across the infrastructure (DevSecOps)
* Continuously improve system reliability, deployment speed, and cost efficiency based on real usage and incidents

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3\-7 years of DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering experience
* Must have hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Strong scripting ability in Python, Bash, or Go for automation
* Hands\-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, Terraform preferred
* Solid understanding of CI/CD tools and practices (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent)
* Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, or Puppet)
* Working knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, or equivalent)
* Solid Linux system administration and networking fundamentals (DNS, load balancing, VPC,firewalls)
* Comfortable working end\-to\-end autonomously, from design to production operations

**Who You Are**

* A builder, energized by improving systems that other teams depend on
* Pragmatic, you pick the right tool, not the flashiest one
* Autonomous, you drive toward outcomes without waiting to be told what to do next
* Detail\-oriented, you take reliability and security seriously

**Why Join**

* Ownership of infrastructure and delivery pipelines that power a global fintech platform
* Direct visibility with engineering leadership on architecture decisions
* Path to growing scope and influence as the initiative matures
